title: 借過借過
subject: an overnight porter at a taichung hospital pushing beds, wheelchairs and specimen boxes twenty thousand steps a night, shouting 'excuse me' at every corner, and the grandmother on her way to a two a.m. x-ray who tells him to push faster
caption: Salsa dura in the New York-Puerto Rican style, sung in Mandarin with coro-pregon call-and-response. Two trombones in tight harmony blasting a mambo section; a montuno piano repeating a syncopated two-bar figure locked to the clave; congas playing tumbao with sharp slaps; timbales riding cascara on the shell with a cowbell on the downbeat; deep tumbao on an electric baby bass. Live-room recording, horns up front, dry and punchy, no reverb wash. Male tenor sonero lead, bright and slightly nasal, quick-witted ad-libs, a small male coro answering every line of the hook. 180 BPM, A minor. Cheeky, sweaty, fast-moving night shift. No reggaeton dembow, no trap hi-hats, no autotune, no EDM drop, no pop ballad strings.
lyrics:
[Intro - timbales roll, trombone mambo riff, piano montuno]

[Verse 1]
晚上十點 換上綠色的制服
對講機在腰上 一直喊我的名字
七樓要一張床 五樓要一台輪椅
三號電梯 又停在地下室

[Pre-Chorus]
球鞋的鞋底 快要磨穿了
計步器說 今晚兩萬三

[Chorus]
借過 借過 床來了
轉彎 不要撞到牆
護理站在喊 阿傑快一點
整張床跟著我 在走廊轉一圈

[Verse 2]
凌晨兩點 推一位阿嬤去照X光
她抓著欄杆說 年輕人你推太慢
我說阿嬤坐好 前面要轉彎了
她笑到點滴架 跟著一起搖

[Chorus]
借過 借過 床來了
轉彎 不要撞到牆
阿嬤在後面喊 再快一點
整張床跟著我 在走廊轉一圈

[Bridge - coro and pregon trade lines, trombones answer]
左轉檢驗科 右轉放射科
早上七點交班 我要一碗鹹粥

[Chorus]
借過 借過 天亮了
早班的人 從大門進來
阿嬤推回病房 她說明天見
我推著空床回去 還在數拍子

[Outro - montuno vamp, trombone shout, final timbales break]
